propositions: Replace the module-size allowlist/ceilings exemption mechanism with an absolute 800-LOC cap read from `.github/module-size-limit.txt`.
Implement a limit-lock check that fetches main's tip by explicit GitHub URL and fails if the limit file has changed since main (unless the file is being introduced on the current change).

Rewrite the `Module-size gate` step identically in both `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml` and `.github/workflows/test.yml` to read the limit file, reject any `src/rebar/**/*.py` exceeding the cap, and warn (not silently skip) on fetch failure.
Update `tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py` to drop allowlist/ceilings assertions and verify no file exceeds the cap from the limit file.
Update `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` to list `.github/module-size-limit.txt` as a shared gate signature.
Retain the now-empty allowlist/ceilings files during Phase 2a so main's current gate remains green on the change's CI before Phase 2b deletion.
